newsitem.title: FINLAND: Rauma wins over FIM 300 mln Aker order.
newsitem.headline: Rauma wins over FIM 300 mln Aker order.

text.p: Finnish engineering group Rauma Oy said on Wednesday it won an oil platform hull order worth over 300 million markka from Aker Rauma Offshore Oy.
"Mantyluoto Works Oy, part of Rauma, has signed a contract with Aker Rauma Offshore to fabricate the hull of a Spar oil and gas production platform," Rauma said in a statement.
The manufacturing of the hull began in May as agreed in the preliminary contract and the hand-over is scheduled for February 1998, it said.
The order includes the manufacturing of the floating cylindrical hull of the Spar platform.
The final location of the platform will be in the Gulf of Mexico.
Aker Rauma Offshore Oy is is a subsidiary of the Norwegian company Aker Maritime.
